notes.title: Dark Fantasy Godhood is now available!
notes.content:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3332070/extras/banner.png?t=1736923615

After a long, long time in development Dark Fantasy Godhood is finally available for you to play. 

The game is an RPG Adventure game that puts you into the shoes of a young man who becomes the new god of thunder in a very dark medieval world. 

This new power is incredible and will change your life forever. 

Question is, now that you have all this power, what will you do with it?

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3332070/extras/1736028675.jpg?t=1736923615

The game currently has hours of content depending on which playstyle you want to play. No route is locked in. YOU decide the type of demigod you want to be.

Join our discord if you have any questions.
https://discord.gg/akdVJ7pfut

Updates will follow every month. You can also expect more customization and more outfits for every single romance-able girl in the game, not just girls in your party.

Thanks!

- RPMeister
